title: MKG-attention: Budget-aware multimodal graph retrieval for faithful video question answering
selection_reason: MKG-Attention localizes and sparsely injects evidence under fixed online budgets and selectively verifies high-risk answers, directly controlling VideoQA inference context and cost.
